name: Temporary Residence Permit -- Family Reunification

requirements.blocker_text: The sponsor must have legally resided in Lithuania for at least 2 years, hold a residence permit valid for at least 1 more year, and show reasonable prospects of acquiring permanent residence. This 2-year requirement is waived for sponsors who are asylum recipients, researchers, EU Blue Card holders, investors, or ICT intra-corporate transferees.

Spouse or registered partner (both 21+, unless the sponsor holds EU long-term resident status), unmarried children, dependent adult children (dependent 1+ years with no other family support), or elderly/disabled parents.
Proof of sufficient financial resources and adequate accommodation, plus health insurance with at least EUR 6,000 coverage.

evidence_required.document: Marriage/partnership or birth certificate proving family tie
Sponsor's residence permit and proof of 2 years' legal residence
Proof of financial resources and accommodation

sources.title: European Commission EU Immigration Portal -- Lithuania family reunification: sponsor 2-year residence requirement (with exemptions for asylum recipients, researchers, Blue Card holders, investors, ICT transferees), qualifying family members, financial/accommodation/insurance requirements
